name: ukhsa
author: Nik Colley
//: Terminal commands for the scripts below:
npm test                  - run all tests headless (no browser window), against SIT
npm run test:sit          - run all tests against SIT
npm run test:e2e          - run all tests against E2E
npm run test:live         - run against live - sprint tests only run if tagged @live-safe
npm run test:master       - start the GitHub Actions workflow against master on GitHub (add -- -f environment=e2e to pick the environment)
npm run test:head         - run all tests with the browser visible
npm run test:ui           - open Playwright's interactive UI (API, accessibility and Chromium ticked - tick more under Projects); type tags like @S3 @US4 in the Filter box
npm run test:api          - run only the API tests (no browser needed)
npm run test:a11y         - run only the accessibility tests (WCAG 2.2 AA scans, keyboard and structure checks)
npm run test:visual       - check the UKHSA homepage layout matches the last passing run (updates the baseline on a pass)
npm run test:visual:reset - throw away the saved screenshot and take a fresh baseline
Pick a sprint or user story with --grep, e.g. npm run test:e2e -- --grep @S2   or   npm run test:sit -- --grep "@S3 @US4"
Add Playwright options after --, e.g. npm run test:head -- --project=chromium
